content.hebrew: אֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ גֹּאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל, דָּר בַּשְּׁחָקִים,
content.transliteration: En Kamokha go’el Yisra’el, dar bash’sheḥaḳim,
content.english: None is like You, redeemer of Israel, who dwells in heaven!

content.hebrew: הוֹרֵֽיתָ לָּֽנוּ בְּהַר סִינַי מִצְוֹת וְחֻקִּים,
content.transliteration: Horeta lanu behar Sinai mitsvot veḥuḳḳim,
content.english: You taught us commandments and statutes on Mount Sinai,

content.hebrew: רְפוּאוֹת לֵב הֵם, רְצוֹן הָאֵל מְפִיקִים.
content.transliteration: Refu’ot lev hem, retson ha’el mefiḳim.
content.english: Which are healing for the heart, and express God’s will.
They drip comb honey and are sweeter than nectar.
They are firmly founded in the most excellent mercy and compassion.
You have brought us near to serve You, to uphold Your statutes.
Six years may we sow the land,
And the seventh is a Sabbath unto Adonai, who loves the righteous;
Its produce is for every living thing, whether full or empty.
We should be occupied with sanctifying the fiftieth year,
To proclaim liberty, [such that] each man will embrace his clan;
It is a Jubilee, to lead the displaced [back] to their inheritance.
We must hold fast to uprightness in buying and selling,

content.hebrew: וּמָךְ וְדָל – אִיֹש כְּפִי כֹחוֹ לָהֶם מַעֲנִיקִים,
content.transliteration: Umakh vedal – ish kefi khoḥo lahem ma‘aniḳim,
content.english: And give gifts—each according to one’s means—to the indigent and poor,
And dismiss [anyone] in difficulty from giving us a hand.

content.hebrew: מַה נִּפְלְאוּ דִּבְרֵי אֵל, בְּצֶֽדֶק חֲקוּקִים;
content.transliteration: Ma nifle’u divrē El, betsedeḳ ḥaḳuḳim;
content.english: How wondrous are God’s words, which are inscribed in justice;

content.hebrew: רַחֲמָיו לֹא כָלוּ מֵאֲשֶׁר בּוֹ דְבֵקִים,
content.transliteration: Raḥamav lo khalu me’asher bo deveḳim,
content.english: His compassion is never depleted for those who cling to Him,
And it will never be insufficient to redeem His oppressed children

content.hebrew: קהל: מִיַּד עֹשְׁקֵיהֶם, בְּכָל־עֵת לָהֶם מְצִיקִים.
content.english: Cong. From the hand of their oppressors, who distress them at all times.
Cantor. And then—

content.hebrew: יֹ֭אמְר֖וּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יו֑י אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר: (תהלים קז:ב)
content.transliteration: Yomeru ge’ulē Adonai asher ge’alam miyyad tsar:
content.english: Those redeemed by Adonai will say that He has redeemed them from the hand of the enemy. (Ps. 107:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיה מז:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “Lord of Hosts.”
